description.content:
Returns a list of files associated with a matter. 
Defaults to ascending order of date created, i.e. oldest first, unless sort option is supplied.
Custom sorting and searching options does not apply to cursor-based pagination.

REST API for integrating with Smokeball legal practice management software. Supports matters, contacts, documents, time entries, billing, trust accounting, staff, webhooks, and law firm workflows across US, AU, and UK regions. Uses OAuth 2.0 (client credentials) authentication.
